By Birkhoff, cylinder Cesaro averages converge simultaneously on a full-measure set; shifting changes each average by at most 1/n, so choose a strictly invariant version of the limit vector psi. Let nu=law(psi) and use the published standard-Borel RCD supplier for K_lambda=law(x|psi=lambda). Birkhoff identifies psi_j with E[1_Cj|I]; approximate invariant indicators in L1 by cylinder-simple functions and apply conditional expectation onto I to show I and sigma(psi) agree modulo null sets. Test stationarity against bounded psi-measurable functions and countably many C_j to prove K_lambda(T^-1 C_j)=K_lambda(C_j), then extend by measure uniqueness. Disintegration gives K_lambda(psi=lambda)=1; simultaneous cylinder limits then have K_lambda-probability one. To prove K_lambda ergodic, for an invariant B approximate 1_B in L1(K_lambda) by cylinder-simple f; averages of f converge to its K_lambda mean by the component cylinder-limit identities, while averages of 1_B equal 1_B. L1 contraction of averaging gives ||1_B-K_lambda(B)||_1<=2||1_B-f||_1; take the approximation error to zero, so K_lambda(B) is 0 or 1.
